messages:
sara: quick design follow-up from usability pass on the Eval -> Prompt Sets compact list. focused on regression diffs, approval CTA clarity, and a11y keyboard flows. TL;DR: tighten spacing, clarify bulk CTA, add keyboard-friendly legend.

mike: can you paste the prototype?

sara: https://figma.com/file/compact-evals/flow-v4 (frame: compact-list-regressions)

anya: Observations: 1) visual separation between the diff preview and metadata row is weak when diff text wraps. propose a subtle 1px divider + 12px left padding inside diff container.

mike: agree. also ensure divider color token adapts in dark mode.

sara: noted. 2) Bulk toolbar: primary action reads "Approve selected" which is long. suggestion: make primary "Approve" and add a plain secondary link "Approve & add note" that opens the modal pre-focused on the note field.

david: prefer single primary action for consistency. if we show secondary, it must be visually lower-weight. backend needs a flag to accept approveWithNote. i'll open a ticket.

anya: modal copy: title should be "Approve test suite — add release note" and note field optional unless team setting requires it. confirmation button stays "Approve".

ux-bot: mock: https://figma.com/file/compact-evals/approve-modal-v2 :white_check_mark:

mike: 3) legend/scorecard: currently inline legend crowds the header. propose a collapsed disclosure "Legend" that expands to show color + pattern icon (for colorblind users). disclosure tabbable and has aria-controls.

sara: reuse existing chart pattern tokens (diagonal/hatch) and include accessible label e.g., "High severity — red, diagonal pattern".

anya: 4) keyboard interactions: when a row is focused, Enter should toggle inline diff expand and place focus on first action inside (three-dot menu). single-letter shortcuts (r = re-run, m = mark expected, i = ignore) can be shown in the menu but only active when the row has focus to avoid global conflicts. document shortcuts in help.

david: add small tooltip showing shortcut next to menu items on hover. implement row-scoped key handling by checking aria-selected/focus.

mike: 5) thumbnails: keep fixed aspect ratio, add 1px neutral border and 6px radius. in dark mode use inner stroke instead of shadow.

anya: 6) badge phrasing: change to responsive copy. xs: "Fail (3)"; md+: "3 regressions". avoid passive phrases like "failed" so it reads less judgmental.

sara: empty state copy: replace "No diffs — everything looks good" with "No regressions found" and include CTA "Run full test suite" plus hint "Press R to run (focus a row)". show a 4s undo toast if a keyboard-run is queued.

david: accessibility checklist: aria-expanded on row, aria-controls on disclosures, visible focus outline for keyboard, esc to close popovers, aria-live for run start/complete. I'll slot a 2pt spike to validate focus flow.

mike: small copy nits: use sentence case in modal titles and button labels. keep CTA verbs short.

sara: i'll update the figma frames and assemble a short PRD summarizing decisions and copy options. will tag @anya @david for copy + a11y review.

ux-bot: PRD draft created: https://internal.redwood.ai/prd/evals-compact-1789998888 reviewers: @anya @david @mike

anya: :thumbsup: will add final copy suggestions tomorrow.

mike: thanks — will coordinate with eng for the spike.

sara: thanks team, ping when ready to handoff.
